title: Identification of TIMP1 as an inflammatory biomarker associated with temporal lobe epilepsy based on integrated bioinformatics and experimental analyses
summary: Random forest and support-vector-machine analyses of merged hippocampal gene-expression datasets identified TIMP1 as the strongest inflammation-related gene associated with temporal-lobe epilepsy. Immunofluorescence localized TIMP1, while qPCR and western blot showed decreased expression in patients and kainic-acid-induced mice; this supports a biomarker association, not a causal mechanism. The result remains bounded to the reported datasets and assays.
